designNotes.levelCurve: Infinite character levels. XP starts at 80 and grows 16% per level, keeping early progression fast while maintaining a long-term curve.
designNotes.skillCurve: Every character level grants one skill point. Skill ranks are infinite with no hard cap; each rank applies its defined linear stat bonus.
designNotes.rewards: Wave rewards are tuned for steady progression, with equipment and dungeon rewards providing larger power spikes.
designNotes.persistence: Level, XP, gold, skills, equipment and materials persist between runs and dungeons.
